name: hover-in-then-out-frost-jump-check
description: follow-up: a quick hover in then immediately out can dismiss the panel while the frost's reveal fade is still running. AnimateHide now reads the frost's live presentationLayer opacity as its fromValue instead of hardcoding 1, so an interrupting dismiss should continue the fade smoothly rather than snapping brightness up before fading back down. This scenario is a raw frame capture for visual inspection, not a pass/fail gate - the same posture as peek-open-close-animation-frames.json.
